containerDefinitions.name: bootstrap
command: set -e; mkdir -p reports; echo '=== 3.2 seed_lectures ==='; uv run python scripts/seed_lectures.py || echo 'seed_lectures FAILED'; echo '=== 3.5.2 backfill_schema_v2 ==='; uv run python -m src.scripts.schema_v2.backfill_schema_v2 --apply --report-path reports/backfill.json || echo 'backfill FAILED'; echo '=== 3.5.3 validate_schema_v2 ==='; uv run python -m src.scripts.schema_v2.validate_schema_v2 --report-path reports/validate.json || echo 'validate FAILED'; echo '=== 3.5.4 parity ==='; uv run python -m src.scripts.pipeline.check_canonical_runtime_parity || echo 'parity FAILED'; echo '=== 6 create_seed_accounts ==='; uv run python -m src.scripts.create_seed_accounts || echo 'create_seed_accounts FAILED'; echo '=== DONE ==='
